senses.gloss: to flow, run. זוֹחֲלִים, זוֹחֲלִין running waters, opp. to נוטפין dripping water (collected rain water &c.).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 5:5">Mikv. V, 5</cite> <he>הז׳ במעין</he> running waters are like a well (for levitical purposes).
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 5:5">Ib.</cite> <he>נוטפין שעשאן ז׳</he> collected rain water which was made running (by causing an overflow into a channel).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 4:8:2">Y. Shebi. IV, end, 35ᶜ</cite> <he>משיִזְחֲלוּ מים</he> when the berries are sufficiently developed to yield running drops when squeezed, v. <cite ref="C01381"><he>גָּרַע</he> II</cite>. [<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13">Num. R. s. 13</cite>, beg. <he>וזוחלות</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 988:37">Yalk. Cant. 988</cite> <he>זוחלת</he>, read <he>זולח׳</he>, v. <cite ref="G00487"><he>זָלַח</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: to let collected water run into a channel.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 5:5">Mikv. V, 5</cite> <he>אין מַזְחִילִין בו</he> you must not use it for &c.
